name: [PVP] roll the world 🌎
desc:
⚔️ NEW: pvp! reach size 50 to unlock it: everyone starts small, the storm closes in and the biggest ball wins. your normal size is saved for when you come back.

👍 use code 5000LIKES in the shop for 5 star spins + 3 growth potions + 2x luck for 30 min!
>> 10000 likes for a new code!

anything smaller than you sticks to your ball. the bigger you get, the bigger the stuff you can roll up.

🌱 start tiny in the grass with the bugs
🐄 roll up cows, cars and whole streets
🏙️ eat the city and everything that used to chase you
💎 find golden, diamond and rainbow finds, and even rarer ones
⭐ make stars to start over stronger
🚀 leave earth at star 6 and roll up the universe

🌙 day and night, seasons and events like meteor showers and eruptions
🏆 leaderboards for stars, fastest runs and rarest finds

👥 join the overzeer group for +10% growth and the overzeer eye skin!

🎮 supports pc, mobile and console

🎃 halloween till nov 9: zombie nights, pumpkins and haunted finds

llm.loop: roll a ball over smaller objects to grow -> roll up bigger things (bugs, cows, cars, city, planets) -> make stars to reset stronger -> leave Earth and roll up the universe
llm.objectives: grow your ball as big as possible and roll up the universe
llm.progression: ball size, stars (rebirth), rare finds, Earth to space at star 6
llm.instructions: roll up anything smaller than you, find rare finds, make stars to start over stronger, reach size 50 for PvP mode
unique: battle-royale storm PvP where biggest ball wins
llm.thumbnails: giant balls covered in rolled-up objects and smiley-face balls rolling through a voxel city and grass
llm.complexity_notes: physics-based rolling with many attachable objects, multiple scales from grass to space, PvP mode
